newsitem.title: UK: UK meals attract light trade on easier market.
newsitem.headline: UK meals attract light trade on easier market.

text.p: UK meals and feeds traders reported light trading on Thursday as prices easied slightly.
"There hasn't been any great volume but a few bits have been trading on the East Coast," said a trader.
High protein soymeal fetched 193 stg a tonne for spot ex-East Coast stores.
Traders said there was also talk of some fairly heavy soymeal business over the last couple of days but could not confirm this.
"There is talk that spot material has been trading at 194 stg and Nov at 191 stg, but noone will put their hand up and say yes I did it." said one trader.
High protein soymeal sellers were around one stg a tonne lower following the lower Chicago close on Wednesday.
